preamble.summary: Psalm 119 — the great alphabetic acrostic, 176 verses across 22 stanzas (one per Hebrew letter). Multiple dedicated Qumran manuscripts preserve this psalm: 4QPsᵍ and 4QPsʰ are essentially Ps 119 manuscripts; 5QPs preserves substantial portions; 11QPsᵃ includes the psalm in its alternative ordering. The acrostic structure is preserved across all witnesses with no significant variants.
preamble.notable_variants: No significant variants. The acrostic structure is preserved verbatim across all manuscripts. Minor orthographic variation only.
preamble.scroll_condition: Multiple manuscripts preserve continuous text of substantial portions.
